description: This file defines a service layer in a task management system, specifically handling business logic for task operations such as creation, retrieval, updating, toggling completion status, and deletion. It enforces user ownership and interacts with a repository layer for database operations.

classes.name: TaskNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a task cannot be found or is not owned by the user.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Service layer class providing business logic for task operations with ownership enforcement and validation.

methods.name: Task create_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str])
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user, delegates to the repository.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of tasks for a user.

methods.name: Task get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single task owned by a user, raises an error if not found.

methods.name: Task update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str], description: Optional[str], is_completed: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: Updates the fields of a task, raises an error if the task does not exist.

methods.name: Task toggle_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, explicit_state: Optional[bool])
methods.description: Toggles or explicitly sets the completion status of a task.

methods.name: None delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task; if task does not exist, raises an error according to API semantics.
